text: かつと　しょうきんが　もらえ　ポケモンも　つよく　なっていく！

structure.jp: しょうきんが　もらえ
structure.en: you can get prize money, and

structure.jp: ポケモンも　つよく　なっていく！
structure.en: your Pokémon keep getting stronger too!

patterns.name: 〜と (whenever)
patterns.explanation: と after a plain verb means 'when' or 'whenever': this happens, and that always follows. かつと = 'when you win'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: もらえる is the 'can' form of もらう, 'to receive'. Here it is cut down to もらえ, which works like 'and' and lets the sentence go on. もらえ = 'you can get (it), and'.

patterns.name: 〜ていく
patterns.span: つよく　なっていく
patterns.explanation: いく after a verb's て-form says the change keeps going on from now. つよく　なる is 'become strong'. つよく　なっていく = 'keep getting stronger'.
